name: Input
purpose: Render finished native single-line text entry with Brick sizing, states, and Atom field integration.
useWhen: The user enters a single-line text, email, search, URL, telephone, or supported native input value.
composition: Place Input inside one Field.Root after Field.Label; provide name, type, and autocomplete appropriate to the data. Use outline when the containing surface should remain visible and soft when Input should own a filled plane.

rules.statement: Use a persistent accessible label; placeholder is not a replacement.
Load styles.css or core.css plus input.css and field.css when composed with Field.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using placeholder as the only visible label.
commonMistakes.correction: Compose Input with Field.Label and use placeholder only as optional example text.

validation: Inspect label, name, type, autocomplete, and messaging relationships.
Test focus, entry, autofill, invalid/disabled states, zoom, and both appearances.
